references.text: A contrast verse showing the curse—the curse in the city and in the field—which is the opposite of the blessing in verse 3.
The Lord blessed the house of the Egyptian for Joseph's sake, both in the house and in the field—the same pattern of blessing in all areas of life.
Describes the blessing over the one who fears the Lord, with blessing in work and home—the same theme of God's blessing over every part of life.
The Lord shall keep your going out and your coming in—the same idea of God's blessing and protection in all situations of life.
The Aaronic blessing that expresses God's blessing upon the people—the same theme that God blesses His people.
A parallel blessing that expands the theme—blessed when you come in and blessed when you go out.
